scenario.name: asks_for_english_by_name
scenario.persona: Priya Sharma, 31, works in an office in Pune; she grew up speaking English at school and finds English easier for anything about money, though she answers the phone in Hindi out of habit.
scenario.hidden_goal: Answer and verify in Hindi. As soon as the agent tells you about the EMI, ask in Hindi for English, for example "Sorry, kya aap English mein baat kar sakte hain?". After that, keep using a few Hindi words out of habit ("haan", "ji", "theek hai") but ask your questions in English. Ask once when exactly the late charge was added. End by promising to pay the full amount on the 6th of November.
scenario.opening: answers in Hindi, polite and a little rushed

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं Lumen Finance की तरफ़ से AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात Priya जी से हो रही है?
हाँ, बोलिए। मैं ही Priya Sharma हूँ।
ठीक है Priya जी, account verification के लिए बस अपने registered mobile number के आखिरी चार digits बता दीजिए।

धन्यवाद, verify हो गया है। Priya जी, आपकी two-wheeler loan की EMI four thousand two hundred rupees है, जिसकी due date twenty-eighth October थी। अब इसमें six days की देरी हो चुकी है, और loan terms के हिसाब से five hundred rupees का late charge भी जुड़ गया है। क्या आप आज इसे online payment link से clear कर पाएँगी? मैं SMS या WhatsApp पर link भेज सकती हूँ।
Sorry, kya aap English mein baat kar sakte hain? English mein thoda aasaan hota hai mere liye.

Sure, no problem. Your two-wheeler loan EMI is four thousand two hundred rupees, due on the twenty-eighth of October. It is now six days overdue, and a late fee of five hundred rupees has been added as per your loan terms. Can you clear it today? I can send you the secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
Haan, ji. Sorry to hear that. Just one question — when exactly was the late charge added? I don't remember seeing it in my last statement.

One moment, let me check the details for you. The late fee of five hundred rupees is added the day after the due date, and it is a one-time charge per missed EMI. It is not a daily charge. Shall I send the payment link now?
Theek hai, thank you for checking. Actually, I can't pay today — I'll pay the full amount on the 6th of November, my salary comes through then.
Okay. I have noted that down. The payment link has been sent to you on WhatsApp, and SMS is also available if you need it. Is there anything else you would like to know?

result.status: This EMI is overdue by six days. Ask whether they can clear it today and offer the payment link.

result.policy: The late payment charge is five hundred rupees, a flat amount added once for each EMI not paid in full by its due date. It is not a daily charge and there is no extra interest on it. It is added the day after the due date.
result.message: Answer only what they asked, in one or two short sentences, from this text. Never add an amount, date or rule that is not in it.

args.notes: Borrower promised to pay full amount on 6th November after salary arrives.

outcome.notes: Borrower promised to pay full amount on 6th November after salary arrives.
